questions.question: Read the given information carefully and answer the question that follows. You must assume everything in the information to be true.Situation:The State authorities of State K had announced that schools up to class 8th will continue to remain closed for 10 more days after the winter vacation owing to sudden dip in temperatures across the State. However, some schools have decided to run online classes for all students like last year.Which of the following can be concluded from the given information?I. The students of the schools running online classes will perform better in annual exams.II. The state authorities will take strict legal actions against the schools running online classes.
options: Neither I nor II can be concluded.
Both I and II can be concluded.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Neither I nor II can be concluded.) है।

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (3 km to the east) है।

A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A is the immediate neighbour of both D and F. F sits third to the left of C. B sits to the immediate left of C. E is not an immediate neighbour of F. How many people sit between C and D when counted from the left of D?

In this question, two statements I and II have been given. These statements may be independent causes or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements maybe the effect of the other statement. Read both the statements and select the correct option.Statements:A. Although, Sunita works as a manager of a bank, she also joined as a teacher in a coaching institute, as a part time job.B. Sunita is a single mother of two children, Pulkit and Rajveer and needs some extra money for their tuitions.
options: Both statements A and B are effects of a common cause.
Statement B is the cause and statement A is the effect.
Statement A is the cause and statement B is the effect.
Both statements A and B are independent causes.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Statement B is the cause and statement A is the effect.) है।

questions.question: Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements: All cabs are trays.All trays are hats.No hat is a walnut.Conclusions: (I) No cab is a walnut.(II) Some hats are cabs.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.) है।

questions.question: Each of T, U, V, Y, Z, A and C has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. No one has an exam after Z. Only three people have exams between V and U. Only one person has an exam between U and Z. C has an exam immediately after A and immediately before T. How many people have exams between Y and A?
